设 $q\in\mathcal P$，$j\in I_{\mathrm{res}}(q)$。取路径链的受限 Lip 证书

$$
\mathbf L_q\in\mathscr L(c_q)\big|_{U_q},
$$

并令

$$
\mathbf A_q=\mathbf L_q+\mathbf L^*.
$$

**定义（路径分量经验保证域）**：对有限阈值 $\tau_j\in[0,+\infty)$，定义

$$
U_{q,j}(\tau_j)
=
\{x\in U_q:
D_{\mathbf A_q,j}(x;S_{q,j})+\hat\varepsilon_{q,j}\leq\tau_j\}.
$$

对非空 $J_q\subseteq I_{\mathrm{res}}(q)$ 与阈值族 $\boldsymbol\tau=(\tau_j)_{j\in J_q}$，定义

$$
U_{q,J_q}(\boldsymbol\tau)
=

**推论 #h-93b9c20ea18b4e59（路径保证域的全局拟合含义）**：对任意 $j\in I_{\mathrm{res}}$ 与有限阈值 $\tau_j$，

$$
\bigcup_{\substack{q\in\mathcal P\\ j\in I_{\mathrm{res}}(q)}}U_{q,j}(\tau_j)
\subseteq
\{x\in U:d_j(\phi(x),\phi^\natural(x))\leq\tau_j\}.
$$

更一般地，对给定非空分量族 $J\subseteq I_{\mathrm{res}}$，

$$
\bigcup_{\substack{q\in\mathcal P\\ J\subseteq I_{\mathrm{res}}(q)}}
U_{q,J}(\boldsymbol\tau)
\subseteq
\{x\in U:\forall j\in J,\ d_j(\phi(x),\phi^\natural(x))\leq\tau_j\}.
$$

**证明**：若 $x$ 属于左侧某个路径局部保证域，则由 @h-4b5219aa3a3bbdad 得到对应分量的误差上界。对所有 $j\in J$ 同时应用即可。$\square$

theorem path_component_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (tau : ENNReal)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q →
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    {x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
      j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
      x ∈ path_component_empirical_guarantee_domain d
        (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q j
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j) tau}
      ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧ d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau} := by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨q, hj, hxq⟩
  exact ⟨N.path_domain_subset_source hxq.1,
    proxy_path_component_guarantee_error_bound d hd target proxy N sample
      delta_o q Vstar (Lq q) Lstar j tau hrep (hpathV q) (hLq q hj)
      hLstar hj hxq⟩

theorem path_joint_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q →
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    {x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
      J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
      x ∈ path_joint_empirical_guarantee_domain d
        (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q J
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) tau}
      ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau j} := by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨q, hJ, hxq⟩
  refine ⟨N.path_domain_subset_source hxq.1, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hchain :=
    path_chain_eq_represented_proxy_on_path N proxy q hrep hxq.1
  simpa [hchain] using
    (path_joint_guarantee_error_bound d hd target N sample delta_o q
      Vstar (Lq q) Lstar J tau (hpathV q) (hLq q hJ) hLstar hJ hxq j hj)

theorem path_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (tau_j : ENNReal)
    (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hj_evaluable : j ∈ evaluable_components sample)
    (hJ_evaluable : J ⊆ evaluable_components sample)
    (htau_j_finite : finite_ennreal tau_j)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ i : I, i ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau i))
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      (j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∨
        J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q) →
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    ({x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
        j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
        x ∈ path_component_empirical_guarantee_domain d
          (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q j
          (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j) tau_j}
        ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
          d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau_j}) ∧
      ({x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
        J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
        x ∈ path_joint_empirical_guarantee_domain d
          (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q J
          (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) tau}
        ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
          ∀ i : I, i ∈ J →
            d i (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau i}) := by
  have _ := hj_evaluable
  have _ := hJ_evaluable
  have _ := htau_j_finite
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  have _ := htau_finite
  exact ⟨
    path_component_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error d hd target proxy N
      sample delta_o Vstar Lq Lstar j tau_j hrep hpathV
      (fun q hj => hLq q (Or.inl hj)) hLstar,
    path_joint_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error d hd target proxy N
      sample delta_o Vstar Lq Lstar J tau hrep hpathV
      (fun q hJ => hLq q (Or.inr hJ)) hLstar⟩

theorem path_chain_eq_represented_proxy_on_path
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (q : N.ReachablePath) (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ N.path_domain q.nodes) :
    (N.path_chain q.nodes).func x = proxy.func x := by
  have hpath :
      N.extensional_operator.func x = (N.path_chain q.nodes).func x :=
    N.local_equivalent_extensional_path_chain q x hx
  have hproxy :
      N.extensional_operator.func x = proxy.func x :=
    hrep x (N.path_domain_subset_source hx)
  exact hpath.symm.trans hproxy

evidence.quote:
**所给 Lean 实现准确、完整地证明了推论 `h-93b9c20ea18b4e59` 的两个包含式。** 两式右端都保留了 \(x\in U\)，并约束代理与目标在 \(x\) 处的真实偏差。目标文件及其附件依赖已用 Lean 4.29.1 编译通过。[正文推论](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-xhigh-api-20261120/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/source.md:242)

1. **分量形式。** `path_component_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error` 将受限并集的成员条件写成“存在一条可达路径 \(q\)，使 \(S_{q,j}=S_j\cap U_q\) 非空，且 \(x\in U_{q,j}(\tau_j)\)”。保证域使用的矩阵是 \(L_q+L^*\)，残差是同一路径的 \(\hat\varepsilon_{q,j}\)。证明取出见证 \(q\)，由保证域成员条件得到 \(x\in U_q\subseteq U\)，再由 `proxy_path_component_guarantee_error_bound` 得到 \(d_j(\phi(x),\phi^\natural(x))\leq\tau_j\)。这就给出了右端要求的两个条件。[分量定理及证明](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-xhigh-api-20261120/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_14_empirical_network_fitting/path_guarantee_domains.lean:520)

2. **联合形式。** `path_joint_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error` 先取**同一条**满足 \(J\subseteq I_{\rm res}(q)\) 的路径 \(q\)，再对每个 \(j\in J\) 应用 `path_joint_guarantee_error_bound`。该局部界约束路径链 \(c_q(x)\)。源码用网络表示假设和 \(x\in U_q\) 得到 \(c_q(x)=\phi(x)\)，从而把每个分量的界转成正文要求的代理误差界。Lean 的联合保证域把 \(x\in U_q\) 写一次，再要求所有 \(j\in J\) 的证书不等式成立。这与正文的交集写法等价，因为 \(J\ne\varnothing\)，从交集中任取一个分量的成员条件即可取回 \(x\in U_q\)。[联合定理及证明](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-xhigh-api-20261120/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_14_empirical_network_fitting/path_guarantee_domains.lean:553) · [联合保证域定义](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-xhigh-api-20261120/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_12_residuals_and_substitution/guarantee_domains.lean:35)

`path_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error_text` 已将两式合并，并显式列出全局可评估性、有限阈值及 \(J\) 非空。证明中部分前提只以 `have _ := …` 出现，是因为两个底层定理在更宽的参数范围内就能推出相应包含式。上面对受限并集和非空交集的解释是审阅时的定义对照；两个误差包含式本身均已有源码证明，无需补充引理。[正文形式的封装](/private/tmp/math-gauge-astra62-xhigh-api-20261120/sessions/AHR04/physical-1/work/formal_oet/vol_03/ch_14_empirical_network_fitting/path_guarantee_domains.lean:590)

OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（共同锚点加权距离）**
The column-`j` weighted common-anchor distance from a point to a component
sample set.  The same anchor `y` is used for every source component.
-/
noncomputable def weighted_anchor_distance
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (x : X) (E : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨅ y : {y // y ∈ E}, matrix_vector_bound A (fun i => d i x y.1) j
